The wet pavement mirrors the four circular headlamps, while the tower's rough, vertically stained facade crowds the far-right background. <Subject 1> has ordinary living skin beneath the yellow hat and sunglasses, never a metallic or mannequin-like surface. The camera holds a Static Shot with small amplitude at slow speed.

The white sports car pulls away from the concrete tower and accelerates gently along the empty rain-darkened street, carrying <Subject 1> in the driver's seat. Reflections from the headlamps stretch across the wet pavement as the tower recedes and slips out of view. The camera pans right with large amplitude at slow speed, following the car from its parked position until it is small in the distance.
The image cuts completely to black and remains black for a long, silent-feeling moment before the world returns.

When the image returns, <Subject 1> stands alone on the exposed rooftop high over the deserted city, with no sports car anywhere in view. The neon yellow tracksuit remains vivid against weathered concrete and compressed layers of distant buildings. The character has ordinary living skin and a subtly breathing posture rather than the stillness of a mannequin. The camera holds a Static Shot with small amplitude at slow speed.

<Subject 1> walks slowly across the empty rooftop toward the eastern edge, the neon tracksuit moving against the muted concrete and dusk skyline. The camera performs a Tracking Shot with medium amplitude at slow speed, retreating ahead of the character to preserve a chest-up view. At the edge, <Subject 1> stops, lowers the head behind the red heart-shaped sunglasses and looks down toward the wet street far below.

prose.text: Live-action and cinematic in a continuous rain-soaked night take, a wide shot opens on the camouflaged supercar alone beneath hard floodlight beams, with its front storage compartment standing open above the nose. Heavy rain stipples the black asphalt, low steam drifts through reflected light, distant spectators cheer, and the idling engine rumbles under the weather. The camera performs a tracking shot with medium amplitude at slow speed, gliding smoothly rightward and closer without entering the car.

The same unbroken take slides from the open front compartment to the side window, revealing the living ape driver seated inside the camouflaged car with both hands braced on the wheel. Rain rattles against the roof and hisses on the asphalt while the engine note pulses beneath the grandstand roar. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed at window height, staying outside the door and looking through the open window.

Without cutting, the lateral glide carries the left car toward the edge and reaches the white rounded sports car on the right, its four headlamps glowing in the downpour. Inside, the living pink-haired driver turns from the wheel and meets the moving lens directly through orange glasses as rain, engine vibration and crowd noise swell. The camera trucks right with large amplitude at medium speed, briefly centering the driver's stare through the open side window before its gaze continues toward the front of the grid.

The uninterrupted move reveals the living floral bear-like starter at the front of the grid, wearing the deep-red velvet jacket and green helmet marked “100,” one arm held high. The two cars wait behind in their left and right lanes, engines snarling beneath the heavy rain while spectators pound and cheer in the grandstands. The camera trucks right with large amplitude at slow speed, easing to a wider lens while keeping the starter centered and both waiting cars in the composition.

The starter's raised arm snaps down, and both cars launch together in one explosive movement, holding their parallel lanes as their tires throw bright sheets of spray into the floodlights. The two living drivers remain secured at their wheels, engines rising from a tense idle to a hard synchronized roar while the crowd erupts. The camera performs a tracking shot with large amplitude at fast speed, continuing its smooth rightward glide and swinging its view forward to follow the accelerating pair.

Still without a cut, the view rises and retreats to reveal the full wet grid, mirrored floodlights, drifting ground steam and packed tiered grandstands on both sides. The two cars shrink into the rain as their engine notes recede, leaving spray hanging over the start line beneath the continuing roar of the crowd. The camera pedestals up with large amplitude at slow speed while the crane boom carries it backward, widening to an extreme-wide overview until both cars vanish into the storm.

prose.text: Live-action, cinematic night racing photography in 16:9: a wide shot isolates the camouflage supercar beneath hard floodlights, with its front storage lid raised against the rain. The camera trucks right with medium amplitude at slow speed in the opening portion of one unbroken window-height glide, remaining outside the vehicle. Heavy rain strikes the lid and wet asphalt, steam drifts across the wheels, and the crowd roars beyond the barriers.

Without a cut, the camera trucks right with medium amplitude at slow speed and slides into an oblique view through the camouflage car's open side window. The living ape driver appears waist-up inside, both hands fixed on the wheel, while the heart-shaped glasses and neon tracksuit catch the passing floodlight. Rain drums on the roof, the engine idles with a low mechanical growl, and distant spectators cheer through the storm.

The same unbroken move reaches the white sports car as the camera trucks right with medium amplitude at slow speed, preserving the established side of the grid. Through the open side window, the pink-haired living driver turns from the track and makes direct eye contact with the lens, orange glasses glowing against the green jacket. The four headlamps burn in the rain while the second engine idles, water hisses beneath the car, and the grandstands continue to thunder.

The camera trucks right with large amplitude at slow speed, still in the same take, while the lens smoothly widens from 72 mm to 24 mm to reveal the starter ahead and both waiting cars behind. The living bear-like starter faces the grid with one arm raised, wearing the deep-red embroidered jacket over the floral-patterned body and the green helmet marked “100.” Rain sheets through the floodlights, engines rise in pitch, steam crawls across the asphalt, and the packed grandstands swell in anticipation.

The starter's arm drops and both cars launch together. The camera performs a tracking shot with medium amplitude at fast speed, continuing its rightward glide while redirecting smoothly down the lanes to follow the simultaneous acceleration. Yellow wheels and white bodywork burst through standing water, throwing overlapping walls of spray; engines roar, tires hiss and briefly scrabble on wet asphalt, rain pounds the grid, and the crowd erupts.

Still without a cut, the camera pedestals up with large amplitude at medium speed while gliding backward and widening gently from 24 mm to 18 mm. The complete rain-black grid, low steam, barriers, floodlight beams, and packed tiered grandstands spread beneath the camera as the two cars become tiny paired traces and disappear into the storm. Their engine roar recedes under relentless rain, lingering tire spray, and the sustained roar of the spectators.
